result.reason: The clause reaches the fallback position: inspection is limited to once in any 12-month period, requires 30 days' written notice (more protective than 15 days), occurs during business hours, and remains entirely at HDI's cost (more protective than shifting costs after a 10% underpayment). The change is narrowly limited to the previously missing frequency cap and preserves the payment-verification purpose. It does not reach the preferred position because it lacks an independent, confidentiality-bound auditor and an express prohibition on direct systems access. Drafting is clear overall, though the inherited 'may ... have the right' construction and comma placement are awkward.
